title: Assignment to the second tape block
statement: Let $s,a$ be natural numbers, let $f$ and $g$ be functions on the first and second blocks of a combined index set of size $s+a+1$, and let $y$ be an element of their codomain. At the combined index corresponding to any index $i$ in the second block, the function assembled from $f$, $g$, and $y$ has value $g(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index in the second block
